name: Svogthos
description: The Golgari's former guildhall, an ancient Orzhov cathedral, once the lair of the lich parun Svogthir.

description_citations.text: "Undercity (Ravnica)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The five gorgons known as the Sisters of Stone Death overthrow Svogthir; he kills two, but the others rot his body and seal him in the tomb Svogthos.
timeline.quote: Svogthir was overthrown by five gorgons

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Rise and fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Guildpact's Decamillennial anniversary, Savra frees Svogthir and builds him a new body, which he uses to defeat the Sisters, killing two more.
timeline.quote: She freed Svogthir from his tomb and constructed a new body for him

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sobeslav, Jarad's assistant, reads letters in the Guildhall and finds one from Mazirek of the kraul inviting Jarad.

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Sobeslav laughs and tosses the invitation in the rot pit, then decides to investigate and orders fifteen guards assembled.
timeline.quote: Assemble fifteen members of the guard,

citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The group enters Korozda unopposed and Storrev welcomes them to Svogthos, with Rat whispering her name to Ral.
timeline.quote: The Golgari Swarm welcomes you to Svogthos.

citation.work: War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives
citation.text: "War of the Spark: Ravnica—Desperate Operatives" by Greg Weisman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 May 2019.

timeline.summary: Savra raises Svogthir; after he tries to betray her he is disintegrated and she takes over as guildmaster.
timeline.quote: Savra then took over as guildmaster

citation.text: "Svogthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Savra's death the role passes to Jarad.
timeline.quote: passing to her brother, Jarad vod Savo

citation.text: "Svogthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Jarad's death, Vraska moves the Golgari court back into Svogthos.
timeline.quote: Vraska moved the Golgari court back into Svogthos

citation.text: "Svogthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral, Kaya, Teyo and Araithia are brought into Svogthos by Storrev seeking aid against the Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: were allowed through Korozda and brought into Svogthos by the lich Storrev

citation.text: "Svogthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska returns and agrees to have the Golgari join the defense against Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska agreed to have the Golgari join the defense of the plane against Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Svogthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker cracks the cathedral walls on the compleated Vraska's command.
timeline.quote: Realmbreaker cracked the cathedral walls of Svogthos on command of the compleated Vraska.

citation.text: "Svogthos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
